description: Umami is a privacy-focused web analytics platform offered as open-source self-hosted software and as Umami Cloud. It collects website analytics and provides dashboards, reporting, and event tracking.
summary: Umami exposes documented HTTP APIs for Cloud and self-hosted analytics management, plus a public event-ingestion HTTP endpoint; no GraphQL or MCP surface was found, and no documented first-party CLI on umami.is was confirmed as targeting umami.is endpoints.
